scope: User explicitly requests intermediate quantizer. Arithmetic child for later full Attention integration; no full Attention claim.
authorization: 2026-10-06 user: 중간에 양자화기를 만들어; W4A4KV4 BF16 scale, activation per-token, weight group32, KV token/head; full projections included.

numeric.input: finite FP32; input exponent0 subnormals and signed zero treated as zero
numeric.scale: BF16 RNE(max(abs(x))/7) computed directly from exact decoded FP32 value; clamp scale >= minimum positive normal BF16 0x0080; zero row uses 0x3f80 (1.0)
numeric.quantized: RNE exact rational x / decoded BF16 scale, saturate signed symmetric [-7,7]; packed two-complement nibble; -8 code not produced
numeric.threshold: rounding compares exact finite input against exactly representable BF16-scale half-integer thresholds, tie chooses even integer; no approximate reciprocal
numeric.granularity: one command is one activation token row, one KV token/head row, or one weight group <=32 as caller chooses
numeric.group_weight_rule: caller invokes rowwise for each output row contiguous input group32; masked tail cmd_elements

protocol.input_count: consume exactly cmd_elements payload handshakes; no input consumption before accepted command
protocol.output_count: valid normal command emits same number of signed INT4 handshakes, same scale for all, tlast only final; output/scale/last stable on stall
protocol.completion: only after all input handshakes processed and last output accepted; no payload requests/outputs for completed command; resp held stable until ready; identity preserved
protocol.invalid_count: 0 or >MAX_ELEMENTS completes with error, consumes no input, emits no output
protocol.nonfinite: any input NaN/Inf: consume entire commanded row then error completion, no output
protocol.reset: cancel current command synchronously, clear all valid/state; caller coordinates bank reset

implementation: two-pass buffered token quantizer; exact constant-divide-by7 scale rounding, exact half-integer threshold quantization; no real/shortreal/dpi synthesis arithmetic; expose standalone streaming child for later native-bank adapter
verification: independent Python bit-exact reference using integer/Fraction calculations
count errors/reset during input or output/at least two MAX_ELEMENTS settings including non-power-of-two
